SFPUC Employee Retirement Recognitions for 25+ Years of Service
items.text: SFPUC Employee Retirement Recognition for 25+ Years of Service Dennis Herrera, General Manager, introduced and recognized Michael Broussard, Anthony Scott, and Frank Marovich as employees who provided service of 25 years or more to the SFPUC. Mr. Herrera thanked the outgoing Commissioners for their tremendous service and professionalism to the PUC on behalf of the SFPUC employees, the citizens, residents, and ratepayers of the City and County of San Francisco. Mr. Herrera stated that he needed to leave the Commission meeting to appear before the Board of Supervisors; he left the dais and Steven Ritchie, Assistant General Manager, sat at the dais at 2:19 PM and served on behalf of Mr. Herrera for the remainder of the meeting

items.title: Bay Area Water Supply and Conservation Agency Report
items.text: Bay Area Water Supply and Conservation Agency Report Nicole Sandkulla, Chief Executive Officer/General Manager, Bay Area Water Supply and Conservation Agency reported that Assembly Bill 2962, by Diane Papan, was signed into law by Governor Newsom and it extends State oversight of the Commission’s implementation of the Water System Improvement Program through January 1, 2036; the BAWSCA Board selected a new incoming General Manager, Tom Smegal, effective December 1, 2024 and she would like to introduce Mr. Smegal to the Commission in December; and, Ms. Sandkulla thanked Commissioners Paulson, Rivera, and Ajami for their service to the PUC and the City and County of San Francisco

items.title: CONSENT CALENDAR
Amendment No. 4 to Contract No. CS-1101, Software as a Service Agreement, with Yardi Systems, Inc., to increase the contract amount and add a tenant insurance compliance module
items.text: Approve Amendment No. 4 to Contract No. CS-1101, Software as a Service Agreement, with Yardi Systems, Inc., to increase the contract amount by $210,649 for a new total contract amount of $725,938, and to add a tenant insurance compliance module to the contract’s software subscription services

items.title: Award Contract No. WD-2844, 12-Inch Ductile Iron Water Main Installation on Parnassus Avenue, to Basset Engineering, in the amount of $8,118,045, to install water mains in the Sunset District of San Francisco
items.text: Award Contract No. WD-2844, 12-Inch Ductile Iron Water Main Installation on Parnassus Avenue, from Stanyan Street to 6th Avenue, on Lawton Street from 7th Avenue to Funston Avenue, and Various Street Locations, to the responsible bidder that submitted the lowest responsive bid, Basset Engineering, in the amount of $8,118,045 and with a duration of 616 consecutive calendar days (approximately one year and 8 eight months), to install water mains in the Sunset District of San Francisco. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the SFPUC SEPTEMBER 24, 2024 MEETING MINUTES 3 purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action

items.title: Accept work performed by D’Arcy & Harty Construction, Inc., under Contract No. WW-724, Panhandle and Inner Sunset Large Diameter Sewer Rehabilitation
items.text: Accept work performed by D’Arcy & Harty Construction, Inc., under Contract No. WW-724, Panhandle and Inner Sunset Large Diameter Sewer Rehabilitation; approve Modification No. 1 (Final) decreasing contract amount by $3,801,235, for a new total contract amount of $6,136,120, with no change to contract duration, for a total contract duration of 515 consecutive calendar days (approximately one year and five months), to reduce scope from the contract and to adjust the final contract amount to the value of actual contract quantities completed; and authorize final payment to the contractor

items.title: Approve Modification No. 1 to Job Order Contract No. JOC-90, General Engineering (A License) Construction, with GSW Construction, Inc., to allow additional time to complete ongoing facility and asset improvements
items.text: Approve Modification No. 1 to Job Order Contract No. JOC-90, General Engineering (A License) Construction, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, and Alameda Counties with GSW Construction, Inc., to increase the contract duration by one year, for a total contract duration of three years, to allow additional time to complete ongoing facility and asset improvements

items.title: Award Contract No. WW-755, Sunnydale Pump Station Safety Improvements, to Anvil Builders, Inc., to address water intrusion, health and safety conditions, and security issues at the Sunnydale Pump Station
items.text: Award Contract No. WW-755, Sunnydale Pump Station Safety Improvements, to the responsible bidder that submitted the lowest responsive bid, Anvil Builders, Inc., in the amount of $8,069,600, and with a duration of 1,155 consecutive calendar days (approximately three years and two months), to address water intrusion, health and safety conditions, and security issues at the Sunnydale Pump Station. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action

items.title: Installment Sale Agreement to secure a Clean Water State Revolving Fund Loan for the Wastewater Enterprise New Treasure Island Wastewater Treatment Plant project
items.text: Authorize the General Manager to execute an Installment Sale Agreement to secure a Clean Water State Revolving Fund Loan for the Wastewater Enterprise New Treasure Island Wastewater Treatment Plant project in an amount not to exceed $120,300,000, with a Water Recycling Grant of up to $8,000,000. Agenda Item Nos. 8 and 9 were considered and voted on concurrently

items.text: Approve Amendment No. 1 to Contract No. PRO.0168.B, Engineering Services for Transmission Pipelines, with Kennedy/Jenks Consultants, Inc., and AGS, Inc., Joint Venture, increasing the contract amount by $10,000,000, for a total not-to-exceed contract amount of $17,000,000, with no change to the contract duration, to provide additional engineering design and support services for five transmission pipeline capital improvement projects funded by the Water Enterprise Capital Improvement Program, subject to Board of Supervisors approval under Charter Section 9.118

items.text: Award Contract No. PRO.0239, New City Distribution Division Campus at 2000 Marin Construction Management Staff Augmentation Services, to Consor PMCM, Inc., for an amount not to exceed $10,720,500 and with a duration of four years and three months, to supplement San Francisco Public Utilities Commission Construction Management Bureau staff in overseeing the construction of the new CDD Campus at 2000 Marin Project, subject to the Board of Supervisors’ approval under San Francisco Charter Section 9.118.
